example-note.title: Example Note
example-note.content:
This is an example note to demonstrate the Quartz notes system.
Features

Backlinks: Notes can link to other notes
Tags: Organize notes with tags
Search: Full-text search across all notes
Graph view: Visual connections between notes

You can write in markdown and use all the standard formatting.
Next Steps
Replace this with your own notes and ideas!
